description: `card` is the card waiting for his button, or null. `id` is what the answer posts back; `tool` is the tool's name and `action` what it would do, in words; `source` the app of an `mcp__app__tool` ('' for a built-in tool); `letter` is true when it would send a letter, whose `to`, `subject` and `body` are in `args`; `args` are the arguments the model proposed (a client draws the short ones and never the large ones it is not shown). `device` is the paired device whose turn asked, or null when none did; a card is served only to that device and the host's own UI (ADR 0218), so a phone never reads another device's.

args.body: Can we move it to ten?
args.subject: Thursday
